...{Fortunate are we}

[Yes]

{..but}

[Yes]

Hashem Yisborach..

[……..]

[….….]

{..}, how is it possible {..} to live in the world without desires?

I only eat, I only eat a little, nu, but one does not need all this

[..I said, said to one:

“If, if, if the Breslov chassidim knew who Yisroel Ber is

They would throw away all the honor and all the money and the publicity

And they would search, seek to draw close, that he should draw them close to Rabbainu”]

Then, as I am telling you

[Yes]

I cannot, cannot understand, how is it possible to live in the world without any desire?

[Saba, Saba, then what, what, what is your avodah now? You no longer have avodah with the desires, but Hashem Yisborach, He has no end, so what is the avodah now? Saba]

Do not speak to me

[Not to ask]

Here I am here, {…}, afterward I am there, I, I am in a place th.. {they do not know\I did not have} th.. any, any, any creature in the world

I will not say a falsehood, that I have no desire; how is such a thing possible?

[I believe you, Saba]

I cannot speak

If I speak like this, then, then the whole world will go after me like a madman

[Ay, ay, ay..]

{..Oy vey}, what kind of world is this?

[I did not hear..]

I am ashamed to say

[Yes]

That I have no desire, ashamed, nu, if a person is dead, I understand

But alive? What..? I do not {{}}, cannot understand this

Such a “Likutay Tefillos,” that every utterance can change the whole world from one extreme to the other, the whole world

{…..}

Ah, ah, Boruch Hashem I am in the world, I have a place to sleep, {..}, like the whole world

{How} my sons, how could they tolerate me?

{I …….}, can take them to another side, to another world
